## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py` covering local-mode cycle ledger init.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2 (partial): local cycle ledger at $ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json with per-branch + SHA-aware semantics.

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_local_workflow_reads_existing_ledger`
2. `test_local_workflow_starts_fresh_when_no_ledger`
3. `test_local_workflow_resets_on_sha_change`
4. `test_local_workflow_continues_on_same_sha`
5. `test_local_workflow_no_pr_reconstruction_path` — assert `reconstruct_from_pr_comments` NEVER called in local mode.
6. `test_concurrent_init_no_lost_cycle_entries` — use `multiprocessing.Process` to spawn 2 parallel `_init_local_ledger` calls against the same ledger path; assert each gets a distinct cycle_num OR both see the same starting state and serialize via the fcntl lock; assert no lost cycle entries (read final ledger; cycles list contains both writes).

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_ledger.read_ledger` and `cycle_ledger.reconstruct_from_pr_comments` (for tests 1-5). Test 6 uses REAL multiprocessing on a real tmp_path ledger file — no mocking of the lock layer (else the regression test is meaningless).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 6 test methods defined with names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py -q --co | grep -c 'test_'   # expect 6
- [ ] All 6 tests fail (local_workflow module does not exist + lock not implemented)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR|ModuleNotFoundError)' | wc -l   # expect ≥ 6
- [ ] Lint + format
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py && ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py (new, ~220 lines)
